description: EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System) for one CVE from FIRST's public API: the estimated probability (0 to 1) of exploitation in the next 30 days, its percentile among all scored CVEs and the scoring date. EPSS predicts; it does not say an exploit exists (see cisa-known-exploits). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_epss_exploit_score
title: Security Epss Exploit Score
